qa.what_happened: On day 6, the study was stopped early due to a breakdown in compliance among the prisoners. Specifically, Prisoner 6395 had been challenging the rules and testing the boundaries, leading to multiple verbal warnings from various officers. By the end of the day, Prisoner 6395 showed compliance, but not without a significant struggle. Officer Fenn found himself struggling with the balance between enforcing the rules and showing empathy, feeling that the strict application of authority was necessary to maintain order.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Fenn, I was the one delivering those verbal warnings and trying to maintain control.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a relentless cycle of warnings and strict compliance. The pressure was intense, and I could feel myself struggling to maintain my resolve. The repeated verbal warnings from the officers, especially towards Prisoner 6395, were particularly draining.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. The experience was vivid and unsettling.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment conducted by Philip Zimbardo.

qa.what_happened: I gave multiple warnings to prisoner 6395 throughout the day, with the last one coming right before lights out. Despite the increasing severity of the warnings, 6395 complied each time, which was unexpected.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The behavior of the prisoners and my own actions were quite consistent with what I described in the diary.

qa.what_happened: During the debriefing, I recounted the recent events where I had issued multiple verbal warnings to Prisoner 6395, escalating from mild to severe as the day progressed. Despite these warnings, 6395 complied with the rules until the lights-out period, which left me feeling conflicted and exhausted.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, those interactions were my actions as Officer Shaw throughout the day.

qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, a prisoner in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, though the setting and scale are different.
